Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I've been writing to two pen pals, one is Guinean and the other is Haitian. The Guinean one comes from an area without a lot of resources and often tells me about how poor her family is, while the Haitian one writes to me about her exciting travels, so I know her financial situation is much better. Who is very poor?
A. The Guinean one
B. The Haitian one
C. Cannot answer
